def mod_pow(base, exponent):
    MOD = 1000000007
    res = 1
    b = base
    e = exponent
    while e > 0:
        if e & 1:
            res = (res * b) % MOD
        b = (b * b) % MOD
        e >>= 1
    return res

def main():
    p, k = map(int, input().split())
    q = k
    if k == 0:
        print(mod_pow(p, p - 1))
        return
    if k == 1:
        print(mod_pow(p, p))
        return
    cycle_length = 1
    while q != 1:
        q = (q * k) % p
        cycle_length += 1
    print(mod_pow(p, (p - 1) // cycle_length))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
